page.overview:
Who is Psuchawrl?

Psuchawrl is a fictional character created by Charles R. Tanner for his 1941 Cthulhu Mythos short story "Out of the Jar".

One of the alien Jinn who came to the Earth in prehistory, Psuchawrl cannot be killed by humans, but was instead imprisoned in a jar by King Solomon, and can only be freed by breaking the jar's seal. Their physical appearance is that of a 9 ft tall humanoid with an eyeless sea anemone-like face, a beaked grinning mouth, and a pronounced ridge running from the forehead to the nape of the neck. (: "Out of the Jar")
